slices.description: state_dir moves under projects/ and every reader follows.
steps: Tests prove a fresh install writes lock, manifest and targets under $HARNESS_HOME/projects/<project-id>/ and adds no other new top-level entry to $HARNESS_HOME.
Tests prove doctor, status, update, agent install and session.sh work with the new state dir.
Tests prove a 0.13.0-layout $HARNESS_HOME/<id>/ migrates into projects/<id>/ on init.sh and on update --root, idempotently.
Tests prove runtime dirs are untouched, an existing target is never overwritten, two projects migrate independently, and an id equal to a runtime dir name cannot clobber it.
